HostedBankLink.description: Owner/session-bound bank link. Recovery revalidates a live login authenticated within 15 minutes. Current reads omit launch URLs. A masked result does not approve KYC and the owning application independently resolves its provider proof.

launch_url.description: Short-lived owner-only approved hosted URL. Never cache, persist or log. Present only while awaiting user input.

payouts_pending.description: Country-wide pending payout amount; present only for global operations administrators. Omitted for delegated regional/franchise viewers.

documents.description: BICYCLE requires IDENTITY. Motor vehicles require IDENTITY, DRIVER_LICENSE, VEHICLE_REGISTRATION and INSURANCE. Kinds and private asset references must be distinct. LICENSE is a legacy spelling of DRIVER_LICENSE and cannot satisfy a second kind.

phone_masked.description: Optional legacy display mask. A caller mask is never provider-verified contact proof. The normal mobile app omits it.

vehicle_type.description: BIKE is a legacy alias with the same complete evidence requirements as MOTORBIKE.

get.description: Internal owner operation for a current fresh-MFA administrator source session. Directory/session revision and read plus export scopes are locked and rechecked. Country authority is derived from the directory, not fulfillment role headers. UTC completion-day boundary matches the dashboard. No payout, location or attendance details. An append-only owning audit must commit before success.

post.description: Approval requires current country reviewer authority with MFA, private media readiness, an independent KYC attestation for the exact rider document set, and bank verification. Only a successful approval marks rider document OCR statuses VERIFIED. Rejected or unavailable proofs leave application revision, state and documents unchanged. A separate independent OCR resolver is not yet part of the rider review path; provider configuration is deployment dependent.
